title: Firma Skies Core
description: A core mod for Firma Skies modpack that include various tweaks and fixes.
body:
## Currently this mod includes these features

- Compatibility layer between Terra Firma Craft's storage and Create's contraptions,
- Abbility for Create's steam engines to consume Terra Frima Craft's water,
- Heating up charcoal forge with encased fan block (WIP),

and many more coming in future.
